metadata.title: Voice Message Tool for Smart Home Speakers

story.iWant: Annie to send voice messages through my Alexa devices
story.soThat: Annie can provide ambient, hands-free communication when I'm at home with emotional expression capabilities

tasks.task: Implement VOICE_TYPES mapping - dict with method (tts/announce) and SSML templates
Implement cooldown mechanism - 60s cooldown, only on success
Implement device validation - query HA media_player domain, fail-all on invalid
Implement notify.alexa_media service call with SSML-wrapped message
Implement main handler with flow: cooldown → validate → query HA → validate devices → SSML → send → log
Create tool schema with LLM-guiding description
Register tool in MCP server (tools/__init__.py and server.py)
Write unit tests for cooldown, device validation, SSML wrapping

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Tool registered in MCP server, appears in /tools/list
Calls notify.alexa_media service with SSML-wrapped message
Supports multiple device targets in single call
Supports 8 voice types: say, announce, whisper, excited, disappointed, conversational, news, fun
Cooldown NOT consumed on failed attempts
Validates devices against live HA media_player domain query
Fails entire request if ANY device invalid, returns valid_devices list
Returns clear error codes: COOLDOWN, INVALID_DEVICE, NETWORK_ERROR, CONFIG_ERROR
Tool description guides LLM discretion (home-only, complement, cooldown, voice types)
Logs include: devices, voice_type, cooldown_state, duration_ms, status
Unit tests for cooldown with >90% coverage
Unit tests for device validation with >90% coverage
Unit tests for SSML wrapping (all 8 voice types)
Integration test (skippable) with real HA + Alexa

constraints.constraint: Fail entire request if any device is invalid (no partial sends)
No HA_CONTROL_ALLOWLIST enforcement - use runtime device validation instead
Extend existing home_assistant.py module, do not create new file
Include duration_ms, devices, voice_type, cooldown_state in all log entries

tests.standards: Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Mock httpx responses using AsyncMock and patch. Follow existing test patterns in test_home_assistant_query.py and test_home_assistant_control.py. Use fixtures for common response shapes. Target >90% coverage.

ideas.idea: test_cooldown_blocks_rapid_sends - send twice quickly, verify COOLDOWN error
test_cooldown_allows_after_60s - mock time, verify send works after cooldown
test_cooldown_not_consumed_on_error - error, then immediate send, should work
test_device_validation_queries_ha - verify home_assistant_query called with domain=media_player

test_mixed_devices_fail_all - mix of valid/invalid, verify entire request fails
test_voice_type_say - verify no SSML wrapping, method=tts
test_voice_type_announce - verify no SSML wrapping, method=announce
